# Stock ai-memory Pi extension

`../ai-memory-pi.ts` is intentionally single-file and byte-for-byte generated by
**ai-memory 3.5.1** `install-hooks --agent pi --apply`. There is no local patch:
the upstream HTTP MCP tool bridge, session headers, lifecycle capture, capture
policy, offline spool, compaction deduplication and automatic handoff injection
are all retained. Tests live in `../ai-memory-pi-tests/`.

The generated server is `http://127.0.0.1:49374` and `TOKEN` is `null`. No machine
paths, credentials, custom guidance or local environment overrides are baked
into the source. Upstream resolves authentication per request: embedded token,
then `AI_MEMORY_AUTH_TOKEN`, then `auth-token` under `AI_MEMORY_DATA_DIR` or its
native platform data directory (macOS `~/Library/Application Support/ai-memory`,
Linux `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/ai-memory`). Token rotation therefore
takes effect without restarting Pi. The spool uses the same upstream data-dir
resolution. The installer owns provisioning through official `ai-memory setup`.

Pi gets memory tools from this extension, not a second native ai-memory MCP
entry. Tool calls carry `X-Memory-Actor-Session-Id` and `Mcp-Session-Id` from Pi's
current session. Other native MCP servers are unaffected.

## Regenerate and verify

The script runs the real upstream apply operation against an isolated temporary
extension file, checks byte identity, and verifies that a second apply changes
neither content nor modification time. It never changes deployed configuration.
No trimming, formatting, patching or source rewriting occurs.

```sh
python3 configs/agents/pi/extensions/vendor/refresh-ai-memory-pi.py --binary /path/to/ai-memory-3.5.1
# Deliberate regeneration after reviewing the pinned upstream release:
python3 configs/agents/pi/extensions/vendor/refresh-ai-memory-pi.py --binary /path/to/ai-memory-3.5.1 --write
bun run test:pi-extensions ai-memory-pi-tests
bun run test:pi-extensions:e2e ai-memory-pi-tests
```

Official setup may run `install-hooks --agent pi --apply` through the deployed
repository directory symlink: with the same stock generation settings this is a
no-op, not a custom patch overwrite. A changed upstream version or explicitly
changed generation settings requires deliberate review and regeneration.

The RPC spec runs real Pi and the actual stock extension with a deterministic
local model. Only the external memory HTTP service is replaced. It exercises a
model-issued `memory_status` call and result, dynamic session headers,
authenticated requests, handoff injection and lifecycle capture. It proves the
Pi integration, not a live ai-memory server contract; installer/server checks
own that boundary. No paid model or deployed user configuration is used.
